name: Tender Clear by Fuka Kamata
recipeMemo:
Comments from the Creator
This recipe is based on my own gentle and translucent photographic style. Based on colors that emphasize blues and greens, shadows have a slightly bluish tint. It provides an overall softer tone with reduced clarity. I recommend this recipe when shooting in semi-backlit conditions where more light is taken in as it creates a more translucent look. It achieves good results with plants and landscapes, but also creates a soft, calming ambiance with indoor photos. 
If the blue is too strong for you, adjust white balance to achieve a balance you like.
